tools.name: postgres_plan_compare
tools.description: Compares EXPLAIN output from before and after a change, such as a new index, and shows the timing change and which problems were fixed, remain or are new. It never connects to a database.

before_path.description: Path to a file with the plan before the change

after_path.description: Path to a file with the plan after the change

tools.name: postgres_plan_review
tools.description: Finds why a PostgreSQL query is slow from its EXPLAIN output, in text or JSON: where the time goes, and problems such as sequential scans throwing away rows, wrong row estimates, sorts and hashes spilling to disk, and nested loops run many times. Use after running EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS). It only reads the text you give it and never connects to a database. Suggested indexes are candidates to test.

plan.description: EXPLAIN output as text or JSON. Give this or path

path.description: Path to a file holding EXPLAIN output. Give this or plan
